shortDescription: This module restores the cloud backup on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: cancel
options.description: Specifies to cancel the restore operation.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: deletelatergenerations
options.description: Specifies that all backup generations should be deleted after the generation is restored.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: generation
options.description: Specifies the snapshot generation to restore. The value must be a number.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: restoreuid
options.description: Specifies the UID of the restored volume should be set to the UID of the volume snapshot that is being restored. This parameter can be used only with I(source_volume_uid). The I(restoreuid) parameter is not supported if cloud account is in import mode.

options.name: source_volume_uid
options.description: Specifies the volume snapshot to restore (specified by volume UID). This parameter is required to restore a backup from a different volume. Specified UID must be different from the UID of the volume being restored.

options.name: target_volume_name
options.description: Specifies the volume name/UID to restore onto.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
